tags: @guarantee ok.default-splitters without `splitters`, splits `str` at each of "-", "_", "/" and "." and leaves the splitters out of the result
@guarantee ok.case-change splits where the case changes from lower to upper or from upper to lower, and keeps the case of each part
@guarantee ok.numbers digits are not a case change
@guarantee ok.custom-splitters with `splitters`, splits at those characters instead of the defaults
@guarantee ok.first returns `str` with its first character in upper case and the rest unchanged ("hello world!" gives "Hello world!")
@guarantee ok.first returns `str` with its first character in lower case and the rest unchanged ("Hello world!" gives "hello world!")
@guarantee ok.join splits `str` like `splitByCase` and joins the parts with the first letter of each in upper case ("foo-bar_baz" gives "FooBarBaz")
@guarantee ok.preserve an uppercase letter followed by other uppercase letters is kept ("FooBAR" keeps "BAR")
@guarantee ok.normalize with `normalize` true, each part has only its first letter in upper case
@guarantee ok.join splits `str` and joins the parts by camelCase: the first part starts in lower case, every later part in upper case ("foo-bar_baz" gives "fooBarBaz")
@guarantee ok.normalize with `normalize` true, each part has only its first letter in upper case before the first letter of the result is lowered
@guarantee ok.join splits `str` and joins the parts in lower case with "-" ("fooBar_Baz" gives "foo-bar-baz")
@guarantee ok.lower the case of the input is not preserved
@guarantee ok.join splits `str` and joins the parts in lower case with "_" ("foo-barBaz" gives "foo_bar_baz")
@guarantee ok.join splits `str` and joins the parts in lower case with no separator ("foo-barBaz" gives "foobarbaz")
@guarantee ok.join splits `str` and joins the parts with "-", each starting in upper case ("FooBARb" gives "Foo-Ba-Rb")
@guarantee ok.preserve an uppercase letter followed by other uppercase letters is kept ("WWWAuthenticate" gives "WWW-Authenticate")
@guarantee ok.normalize with `normalize` true, each part has only its first letter in upper case
@guarantee ok.join splits `str` and joins the parts with a space, each capitalised ("this-IS-aTitle" gives "This is a Title")
@guarantee ok.minor-words minor words such as "a", "for" and "to" stay in lower case
